치마.x: My older sister is wearing a red skirt.
치마.e: Also the name of the long, full skirt worn with a hanbok.

대학생.x: I'm a university student. I study Korean.
대학생.t: Pronounced [대학쌩]: ㅅ after a ㄱ batchim becomes tense ㅆ.

쉬다.m: to rest, to take a break; to be closed (shop)
쉬다.x: On weekends I rest at home.
쉬다.e: 쉬는 시간 = break time. Don't confuse with 쉽다 (easy).
쉬다.t: 오늘 가게가 쉬어요 = the shop is closed today.

크다.t: For people, 키가 커요 means 'is tall' (literally 'height is big').

아주.forms: 아주 + adjective/verb: 아주 좋아요, 아주 잘해요
아주.x: The food at this restaurant is very delicious.
아주.e: 아주 좋아요 = very good. A bit more neutral than 너무 or 진짜.

마늘.x: Korean food uses a lot of garlic.
마늘.e: In the Dangun founding myth, a bear ate garlic and mugwort to become a woman.

실수하다.ex: 어제 발표할 때 너무 긴장해서 실수했어요.
실수하다.x: I was so nervous during my presentation yesterday that I made a mistake.
실수하다.e: Literally 'slip of the hand' + 하다 'to do'.
실수하다.t: 실수 is an honest slip; 잘못 suggests real fault or wrongdoing.

예의.ex: 그 학생은 어른들에게 항상 예의가 발라요.
예의.x: That student is always polite to adults.
예의.t: Say 예의가 바르다 for 'well-mannered' and 예의가 없다 for 'rude'; the 의 in 예의 is usually pronounced [이].

저런.ex: 저런 가방은 어디에서 살 수 있어요?
저런.x: Where can I buy a bag like that?
저런.e: Short for 저러한, from 저렇다 'to be like that (over there)'.

시내.x: On the weekend I went shopping downtown with a friend.
시내.t: Homonym: native 시내 also means 'stream, creek'; context makes it clear.

무게.t: Weight 'comes out' with 나가다: 무게가 많이 나가요 'it's heavy'.

삼각김밥.m: triangle gimbap (triangular rice ball wrapped in seaweed)
삼각김밥.x: I bought a triangle gimbap at the convenience store and ate it.
삼각김밥.t: Pronounced [삼각낌밥]: the ㄱ of 김 becomes tense after the ㄱ of 각. To open one, pull the numbered tabs 1-2-3 in order so the film slides out and the seaweed stays crisp.

모델.ex: 그 모델은 키가 정말 크고 멋있어요.
모델.x: That model is really tall and stylish.

치료하다.ex: 의사 선생님이 상처를 잘 치료해 주셨어요.
치료하다.x: The doctor treated my wound well.
치료하다.t: 고치다 can mean 'cure' casually, but 치료하다 is the standard medical word.

변기.x: The toilet was clogged, so I called a repairman.

출연하다.m: to appear (on a show, in a film), to star in
출연하다.ex: 제가 좋아하는 가수가 오늘 밤 예능 프로그램에 출연해요.
출연하다.x: My favorite singer is appearing on a variety show tonight.
출연하다.e: Literally 'come out to perform' plus 하다.
출연하다.t: Use the particle 에: 영화에 출연하다 'to appear in a film.'

자유.x: I like weekends because I have a lot of free time.
자유.e: Literally 'coming from oneself' — acting by your own will.
자유.t: 'Free' as in no cost is 무료, not 자유.

화재.x: A big fire broke out at the market yesterday.
화재.t: News says 화재가 발생했다; in conversation people say 불이 났어요.

오피스텔.m: officetel (studio unit for living or working)
오피스텔.x: I live alone in an officetel near my company.
오피스텔.e: Konglish blend of English 'office' + 'hotel'; it's a studio apartment building.

처벌하다.ex: 법을 어긴 사람은 법에 따라 처벌해야 해요.
처벌하다.x: People who break the law should be punished according to the law.

구매.e: Both syllables mean 'buy'; 매 'buy' and 매 'sell' differ only in hanja.

메모하다.m: to take notes, to jot down
메모하다.x: Jot down the important points in your notebook.

요구.ex: 그 손님은 직원에게 계속 환불을 요구했어요.
요구.x: That customer kept demanding a refund from the staff.
요구.t: 요구 is a firm demand; 요청 is a polite request.

말고.forms: N 말고 N: 이거 말고 저거 · 커피 말고 차 · N 말고도 (besides N)
말고.m: not … but, instead of; other than, besides
말고.x: Do you have any other colors besides this one?
말고.e: From the verb 말다 'to stop, not do' + -고: 'leaving X aside'.
말고.t: Very common when shopping or ordering: 이거 말고 저거 주세요. 말고도 means 'besides': 저 말고도 올 사람이 많아요 'Lots of people are coming besides me.'

면역력.x: Getting enough sleep improves your immunity.
면역력.t: Pronounced [며녕녁] — nasalization; 면역력이 떨어지다 means 'your immunity goes down'.

수혈.x: The patient received a blood transfusion during surgery.

비염.ex: 봄만 되면 비염 때문에 콧물이 계속 나요.
비염.x: Every spring my nose won't stop running because of my allergies.
비염.e: Literally 'nose inflammation'. -염 = inflammation: 위염, 장염, 폐렴.
비염.t: Koreans use 비염 casually for hay fever; the full term is 알레르기성 비염.

태양광.x: We installed solar panels on the roof of our house.
태양광.e: Literally 'sun light'; in energy talk it means solar electricity.

훼손되다.m: to be damaged, to be destroyed
훼손되다.x: Old trees were damaged because of the construction.
훼손되다.e: Literally 'broken and harmed'; -되다 makes it passive.
훼손되다.t: To say someone damaged it, use 훼손하다.

원고.x: The plaintiff filed a lawsuit against the company.
원고.e: Literally 'original accuser'; homonym 원고 also means 'manuscript'.

군대.ex: 한국 남자들은 대부분 군대에 가야 해요.
군대.x: Most Korean men have to go to the military.
군대.t: '군대에 가다' (go to the military) is the everyday way to say someone is doing military service.

대담하다.ex: 그녀는 대담하게 사장님께 자기 의견을 말했어요.
대담하다.x: She boldly told the boss her opinion.
대담하다.e: Literally 'big gallbladder' — traditionally the gallbladder was seen as the seat of courage.
대담하다.t: Don't confuse it with the noun 대담 'a dialogue, interview', which is written with different hanja.

눈치.m: tact, social awareness, sense for others' feelings; someone's mood or reaction
눈치.ex: 그 친구는 눈치가 없어서 자주 실수해요.
눈치.x: That friend has no social awareness, so he often makes blunders.
눈치.e: Probably built on 눈 'eye' — reading the room with your eyes.
눈치.t: A key cultural idea: quietly sensing what others think or want without being told.

되레.x: The person who was in the wrong was the one shouting instead.

어찌.forms: 어찌 + question/exclamation: 어찌 된 일이에요? 어찌 알겠어요?
어찌.m: how, in what way; how could (rhetorical)
어찌.ex: 이게 어찌 된 일인지 설명해 주세요.
어찌.e: The root of 어찌하다 'to do how', which contracts to 어쩌다 and 어쩌면.
어찌.t: More formal or literary than 어떻게; 어찌 된 일이에요? means 'What happened here?'

제거하다.m: to remove, to get rid of, to eliminate
제거하다.ex: 이 세제는 얼룩을 깨끗하게 제거해 줘요.

구실.ex: 그는 감기를 구실로 회사에 가지 않았어요.
구실.x: He used a cold as an excuse not to go to work.
구실.e: Literally 'mouth fact': a reason that exists only in words.
구실.t: A different native word 구실 means 'role': 제 구실을 하다 = to do one's part.

권위.ex: 그 교수님은 이 분야에서 권위가 있어요.
권위.x: That professor is an authority in this field.
권위.t: 권위 is respected expertise, but 권위적 (authoritarian) is negative: bossy and controlling.

포퓰리즘.x: Populist campaign pledges pour out every election season.
포퓰리즘.e: From English 'populism'; in Korean it is almost always critical.
포퓰리즘.t: Korean news uses it for crowd-pleasing handout policies, close to 선심성 정책.

신원.ex: 경찰은 아직 피해자의 신원을 확인하지 못했습니다.
신원.x: The police have not yet confirmed the victim's identity.
신원.e: Literally 'one's origin' — who someone is and where they come from.

발굴.x: Relics from the Baekje period were excavated here.

주둔.ex: 그 지역에는 외국 군대가 오랫동안 주둔해 왔습니다.
주둔.x: Foreign troops have been stationed in that area for a long time.
주둔.e: Literally 'stay and camp'. 주- = stationed: 주한 미군, 주미 대사.

가담하다.m: to take part in, to join (usually something wrong)
가담하다.ex: 그는 범죄에 가담한 혐의를 받고 있습니다.
가담하다.x: He is suspected of taking part in the crime.
가담하다.e: Literally 'add one's shoulder to a burden'.
가담하다.t: Mostly negative contexts: crimes, riots, plots; use 참여하다 for neutral participation.

와해되다.m: to fall apart, to disintegrate, to break up
와해되다.ex: 내부 갈등으로 조직이 결국 와해되고 말았어요.
와해되다.x: The organization eventually fell apart due to internal conflict.
와해되다.e: Literally 'roof tiles coming loose' — a structure breaking into pieces.

소위.ex: 그는 소위 전문가라는 사람들을 믿지 않아요.
소위.t: Often carries a skeptical tone like English 'so-called'; 이른바 is a more neutral native equivalent.

얼추.forms: 얼추 + number · 얼추 다 됐다 'almost done'
얼추.ex: 준비가 얼추 끝났으니까 이제 손님만 오면 돼요.
얼추.x: The preparations are pretty much done, so now we just need the guests.
얼추.t: 얼추 비슷하다 'pretty similar' and 얼추 맞다 'roughly right' are very common collocations.

일편단심.ex: 그는 처음 만난 그녀에게 지금까지 일편단심이에요.
일편단심.x: He has been devoted only to her ever since they first met.
일편단심.e: Literally 'one piece of red heart' — a sincere, loyal heart.
일편단심.t: Famous from 단심가, a late-Goryeo poem by Jeong Mong-ju that symbolizes loyalty.

일희일비.m: swinging between joy and sorrow; reacting to every up and down
일희일비.ex: 작은 결과 하나하나에 너무 일희일비하지 마세요.
일희일비.x: Don't get too happy or too upset over every little result.
일희일비.e: Literally 'one moment joy, one moment sorrow'.

온고지신.m: learning the new by reviewing the old
온고지신.ex: 온고지신의 자세로 우리 전통을 다시 배워야 합니다.
온고지신.x: We should relearn our traditions in the spirit of learning the new from the old.
온고지신.e: Literally 'review the old to know the new' — a saying of Confucius.

매개.ex: 모기는 여러 질병을 옮기는 매개 역할을 해요.
매개.x: Mosquitoes act as carriers that spread many diseases.
매개.t: Usually appears as ~의 매개 역할 or as a modifier: 매개 변수 (parameter).

기와.ex: 태풍 때문에 지붕의 기와가 몇 장 떨어졌어요.
기와.x: A few roof tiles fell off because of the typhoon.
기와.e: Native Korean word for a fired clay roof tile; a tile-roofed house (기와집) was traditionally the home of wealthier families.

결식아동.m: children who skip meals, underfed children
결식아동.ex: 방학 동안 결식아동에게 도시락을 나누어 줍니다.
결식아동.x: During school vacation, lunch boxes are given to children who go without meals.
결식아동.t: Pronounced [결씨가동]; a social-welfare term common in news reports.

원격 수업.ex: 코로나 때 많은 학교가 원격 수업을 했어요.
원격 수업.x: During COVID, many schools held remote classes.

이판사판.m: a desperate, do-or-die situation; nothing left to lose
이판사판.ex: 어차피 이판사판이니까 끝까지 한번 해 봐요.
이판사판.x: It's all or nothing anyway, so let's give it a go to the end.
이판사판.e: 理判 and 事判 were the two kinds of Buddhist monks: those devoted to study and meditation, and those who ran temple affairs. In the anti-Buddhist Joseon era, becoming either kind was seen as the end of the road, so the word came to mean a hopeless, all-or-nothing state.
이판사판.t: Casual and a bit reckless in tone: 이판사판이다 'I've got nothing to lose (so I'll just do it)'.

초치.ex: 외교부는 일본 대사를 초치해 강하게 항의했습니다.
초치.x: The Foreign Ministry summoned the Japanese ambassador and lodged a strong protest.
초치.t: In news, 초치 almost always means calling in a foreign envoy to protest.

신춘문예.m: New Year's literary contest (run by newspapers)
신춘문예.ex: 그는 다섯 번 도전한 끝에 신춘문예에 당선됐어요.
신춘문예.x: After trying five times, he finally won the New Year's literary contest.
신춘문예.e: Literally 'new spring literary arts' — newspapers announce the winners every January.
신춘문예.t: The standard verb is 당선되다: 신춘문예에 당선되다 = to win the New Year's contest.

시어.m: poetic diction, words of a poem
시어.x: The most important word in this poem is 'sea.'

수용미학.ex: 수용미학에서는 독자의 역할을 특히 중요하게 봅니다.
수용미학.x: Reception aesthetics places special importance on the reader's role.
수용미학.e: Literally 'aesthetics of receiving' — a work's meaning is completed by its readers.

민화.ex: 호랑이와 까치는 민화에 자주 나오는 소재예요.
민화.x: Tigers and magpies are common subjects in Korean folk painting.
민화.e: Literally 'people's painting' — colorful, usually anonymous folk art.

부조.ex: 이 탑의 벽면에는 불상이 부조로 새겨져 있어요.
부조.x: Buddha figures are carved in relief on the walls of this pagoda.
부조.e: Literally 'floating carving' — figures rise from a flat surface.
부조.t: Homonym: 부조 (扶助) means a cash gift at weddings or funerals, an everyday word.

구들.m: gudeul, ondol (underfloor heating system); heated floor
구들.ex: 구들은 아궁이의 열로 방바닥을 데우는 난방 방식이에요.
구들.x: Gudeul is a heating method that warms the floor with heat from the fireplace.
구들.e: The native word for the heated-floor system; 온돌 is the Sino-Korean equivalent.
rel: flat stone of the heated floor

유추하다.m: to infer by analogy, to deduce
유추하다.ex: 앞뒤 문맥으로 단어의 뜻을 유추해 보세요.
유추하다.x: Try to infer the word's meaning from the surrounding context.

셰일가스.ex: 미국은 셰일가스 덕분에 에너지 수출국이 되었습니다.
셰일가스.x: The United States became an energy exporter thanks to shale gas.

귀감이 되다.forms: 귀감이 돼요 · 귀감이 됐어요 · 귀감이 될 거예요; formal: 귀감이 됩니다
귀감이 되다.m: to be a model, to serve as an example
귀감이 되다.ex: 그분의 봉사 정신은 많은 사람들에게 귀감이 됩니다.
귀감이 되다.x: His spirit of service is a model for many people.
귀감이 되다.e: Turtle shells (used in divination) and mirrors were guides; 귀감 means a model to follow.
귀감이 되다.t: Pattern: A가 B에게 귀감이 되다 (A sets an example for B).

묘파하다.m: to depict vividly, to portray incisively
묘파하다.ex: 이 소설은 당시 서민의 삶을 생생하게 묘파했습니다.
묘파하다.x: This novel vividly portrayed the lives of ordinary people of the time.
묘파하다.e: Literally 'depict and break through': portraying something to its core.

빈발하다.x: Water accidents occur frequently in summer.

편찬하다.m: to compile, to edit (a dictionary, history or anthology)
편찬하다.ex: 학자들은 십 년에 걸쳐 국어사전을 편찬했습니다.
편찬하다.x: Scholars spent ten years compiling the Korean dictionary.
편찬하다.e: Literally 'edit and compile' — assembling large reference works.

흡족히.x: Grandma smiled and looked at her grandson with satisfaction.
흡족히.t: Pronounced [흡쪼키]; the adjective 흡족하다 is more common.

선결과제.m: prerequisite task, issue to resolve first
선결과제.x: Jobs are the most urgent issue to resolve first.
